quests.title: Your First Warhead
quests.desc: A warhead is a GregTech-built charge: a stainless steel casing around TNT and a payload. The starter recipe in the Assembler makes a Condensed warhead with a fill of 1 from 2 stainless steel plates, 2 TNT and a Fuze Assembly Mk I. Make one and keep it.

quests.title: Demolition Charge
quests.desc: Place a warhead where you want the hole and light it with Flint and Steel, a Fire Charge or a redstone pulse. The fuse is 3 seconds plus 1 second per 3 blocks of blast radius, so a full Condensed warhead gives you 6. Get well clear, and keep other charges away: another explosion sets one off in half a second.

quests.title: Titanium Casing
quests.desc: The Tier 2 casing is made of titanium and holds up to 20 charges, four times the 5 charges of the Tier 1 casing. Its blast types are made in the Assembler at EV, from eight titanium plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive and a Fuze Assembly Mk II. Make a Tier 2 warhead.

quests.title: Missile Chip
quests.desc: Every missile starts as a chip. The GregTech Circuit Assembler makes a Missile Chip T1 at HV from an Advanced Plastic Circuit Board, 2 Advanced circuits and 4 fine gold wire. The Tier 2 chip is made at EV from an Advanced Epoxy Circuit Board, 2 Data circuits and 4 fine electrum wire. Make a Tier 1 chip.

quests.title: Engrave the Schematic
quests.desc: Put the chip and a Red lens (Tier 2: Blue) in the Laser Engraver. The lens is not used up. Slot the finished Missile Schematic into the Galacticraft NASA Workbench to open the missile's page.

quests.title: Missile Body
quests.desc: On the NASA Workbench page, build a Missile Body T1: three compressed steel plates in one column, four Galacticraft Tier 1 rocket fins, a Galacticraft Tier 1 engine and a Guidance Computer Mk I. Compressed plates come from the Implosion Compressor. There is no warhead slot; the warhead goes on at the pad. A better Guidance Computer makes the missile land closer.

quests.title: Stack It on the Pad
quests.desc: Place the Missile Body on the middle of a Galacticraft Launch Pad, then set a warhead on its nose; it seats flush. Sneak and right-click the body with an empty hand to arm it, which turns the stack into a missile.

quests.title: Fuel the Missile
quests.desc: Attach a Galacticraft Fuel Loader to the pad. A Tier 1 missile takes 2,000 mB of RP-1 or Cetane-Boosted Diesel, or better. Fuel left unburned at impact makes the blast up to 25 percent bigger, so a closer target hits harder.

quests.title: Launch Control
quests.desc: Place a Launch Control block within 4 blocks of the pad and power it at HV. Type the target X and Z, or load them from a Data Stick. The screen shows the range (at least 20 blocks, at most 1,000 for Tier 1) and the blast radius to expect.

quests.title: First Launch
quests.desc: Press Launch, or send the block a redstone pulse. After two seconds of warm-up the missile climbs, flies its arc and detonates on impact; a Tier 1 flight at full range takes about a minute. The pad, the fuel loader and the Launch Control come through unharmed. Make sure nobody stands at the target.

quests.title: Tier 2 Missile
quests.desc: Tier 2 flies up to 3,000 blocks and carries a titanium-cased warhead. Its chip is made at EV, its body takes six titanium plates, and it burns 4,000 mB of Dense Hydrazine or better. Build it, fuel it and launch it.

quests.title: Missile Silo
quests.desc: Missiles launch from the Missile Silo, a 5 by 5 tower you build from Light or Dark Concrete (any finish but cobblestone) and clear glass (Tinkers' Construct or EnderIO) around an open 3 by 3 shaft, with a Galacticraft Launch Pad for its floor and a ring of Gantry Beams on top. The controller is an HV machine, and the Energy Hatch sets what it launches: HV for Tier 1, EV for Tier 2, LuV for Tier 3. A silo shot flies 25% farther and scatters half as much. Fit an Input Bus for bodies and warheads, an Input Hatch for fuel, an Energy Hatch and a Maintenance Hatch in place of any wall, glass or floor-ring block, but not the rim or the pad. Feed it a body and a warhead and it stands the missile in the shaft for you. Build the silo and put a Launch Control within 6 blocks of it.

quests.title: Nuclear Warhead
quests.desc: The nuclear warhead is a Tier 3 casing at ZPM, two blocks tall, made in the Assembler from tungstensteel plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive, uranium-235, plutonium and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. It flies only on a Tier 3 missile from the silo. A full warhead blasts 64 blocks, and nothing living inside the inner 60 percent (38 blocks at full fill) survives, bosses included. The top layer of ground is left irradiated for about an hour: cross it in full hazmat armor. Launch one from your silo, and stand well back.

quests.title: Automate the Body
quests.desc: Scan one hand-built body into a Data Stick in the Scanner, then the Assembly Line builds the basic body from plates, fins, an engine, 2 circuits (Advanced for Tier 1, Data for Tier 2) and 250 L of lubricant: 30 seconds for Tier 1, 45 for Tier 2. A better Guidance Computer is fitted afterwards in the Assembler: put the body and the computer in, and the same body comes out with that guidance.

quests.title: Radar
quests.desc: A radar watches the missiles in flight and flags the ones that will land inside its protected radius, which you set on its screen (64 blocks to begin with). The radar is a small 3 by 3 build of Radar Casing, two high, with one casing on top for the dish, which turns while the radar scans. Make the casing four at a time in the Assembler at HV from 6 stainless steel plates. The HV controller sees 128 blocks and the EV controller 256, flat, at any height; put an Energy Hatch of its tier and a Maintenance Hatch in the base. A missile that only passes over is tracked but not a threat. The redstone it puts out on every side is the number of incoming missiles, up to 15. Right-click the controller with a Data Stick to save its link for a battery. Build a radar and power it.

quests.title: Radar Tower
quests.desc: The Radar Tower is a 3 by 3 tower of Radar Casing, 7 blocks tall, with a Gantry Beam mast up the middle. The casing is the same as the small radar's, and a dish turns on top of the mast. Its range comes from its weakest Energy Hatch: 512 blocks at IV, 768 at LuV, 1,024 at ZPM, 1,280 at UV and 1,536 at UHV. Put an Energy Hatch and a Maintenance Hatch in the bottom ring, and set the protected radius from the R button on the controller screen. Build the controller.

quests.title: Air-Defense Battery
quests.desc: The battery holds 4 stacks of 16 SAMs and a Data Stick. Put a stick that carries a radar's link in its slot and it fires by itself at the nearest threat that radar reports, within 256 blocks: one SAM a second at most, 400 EU each. A SAM does 40 damage, so Tier 1 and Tier 2 missiles fall to one and a Tier 3 missile takes two. The warhead goes off where the missile is hit, so shoot early. Make a battery and a SAM.

quests.title: EMP Tower
quests.desc: The EMP Tower sends one pulse when you press Fire, on a redstone rising edge or from a computer. The radius is yours, 4 to 100 blocks, and the pulse costs 25 EU per square block of radius: 90,000 EU at 60. It drains the 64 nearest machines, batteries and Battery Buffers to zero and gives each multiblock one maintenance issue. A missile in range is destroyed 50 percent of the time, has its guidance fried 40 percent and has its warhead set off 1 percent. Build one, and keep it away from your own base.

quests.title: Handheld Tools
quests.desc: The Radar Gun aims 200 blocks and stores that spot as a target; right-click a Launch Control to copy it. The Remote Detonator links to a placed warhead when you sneak-click it, and a right-click lights its fuse from 128 blocks (HV), 256 (EV) or 512 (IV). The Defuser puts a lit fuse out, or takes a missile on its pad apart before the engines light; it lasts 32 uses. Make all three.

quests.title: Ender Warhead
quests.desc: The Ender warhead is a Tier 3 casing made in the Assembler at LuV from tungstensteel plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive, a LuV Emitter, 16 Eyes of Ender and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. It digs no crater. For 8 seconds it pulls every living thing within 24 blocks toward the center, and anything that reaches the middle (within 4 blocks) is sent to one landing spot 40 to 128 blocks away, up to 64 per blast. Bosses are pulled but never sent. It flies only from the silo. Make one.

quests.title: Anti-Gravitational Warhead
quests.desc: The other exotic Tier 3 warhead is built at LuV from tungstensteel plates, Industrial TNT, Plastic Explosive, 2 LuV Field Generators, 4 Nether Stars and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. For 30 seconds it lifts up to 512 plain blocks within 20 blocks off the ground, top layer first, and floats the living things there. Machines and chests stay put, and every lifted block lands again or drops as an item. Make one.

quests.title: Antimatter
quests.desc: Antimatter is the Tier 4 casing: naquadria plates, two blocks tall, up to 128 charges, made in the Assembler at UV from 8 naquadria plates, 2 UV Field Generators, a Quantum Eye, 4 plutonium-241 ingots, 8 Industrial TNT, 4 Plastic Explosive and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. A full warhead blasts 80 blocks, and nothing living in the inner 60 percent (48 blocks) survives, bosses included. It leaves no fallout, and it ends any Red Matter within 200 blocks. The Tier 3 missile carries it from the silo. Make one.

quests.title: Red Matter
quests.desc: Red Matter is the Tier 5 casing, made in the Assembler at UHV from 8 neutronium plates, 2 UHV Field Generators, 2 Quantum Eyes, 2 UHV Emitters, 8 Industrial TNT, 4 Plastic Explosive and a Fuze Assembly Mk III. It digs no crater. A black ball grows from a radius of 2 to 32 blocks at a full casing, eating blocks, killing everything inside (bosses too) and pulling in what is near. It idles for 10 seconds once full-grown and lives 60 seconds at most, a server setting. Antimatter ends it at once. Make one.

quests.title: Fallout Cleanup
quests.desc: A ZPM nuclear blast leaves irradiated earth, hot earth near ground zero, trinitite and a little fallout goo. Mine it in full hazmat armor. Trinitite Shards are macerated at HV into Crushed Trinitite, which a Centrifuge at HV turns into dusts. Goo is dissolved in 1,000 L of nitric acid in a Chemical Reactor at LuV, then centrifuged at EV with krypton and xenon. While goo stands in a chunk its ground never heals: dig it up. Make Crushed Trinitite.

quests.title: Antidote
quests.desc: The Antidote is a syringe made in the Assembler at HV: 1 rubber plate, 1 stainless steel plate and 2 charcoal dust make 2. Hold use for 1.6 seconds and it cures poison, hunger, weakness, slowness, nausea, mining fatigue and radiation at once, then guards you against them for 3 minutes. Armor still keeps the cause off, and it does nothing against fire or explosions. Make one.

quests.title: Launcher Warhead
quests.desc: Your launchers can carry a blast type. Make a Launcher Warhead: High Explosive, Heavy Slug, Incendiary and Phosphorus at HV, Demolition at EV, for the Rocket Launcher and Grim Reaper; Grenade HE (HV) and Grenade Cluster (EV) for the Grenade Launcher; EMP (LuV) for the Nuke Launcher. Craft it with the launcher in the crafting grid for 4 charges, up to 16. Each shot spends one charge and the launcher's own round, and goes off as a small blast; center damage is capped at 1.25 times the launcher's own. Make a High Explosive one.

quests.title: Golden Dome
quests.desc: The Golden Dome is a yellow OpenComputers floppy with ready-made programs, made in the Assembler at HV from a blank floppy and a Good circuit. Put it in a computer's disk drive, and link your machines through an Adapter. The launch program fires a missile (it always asks first), radarwatch lists radar contacts with an alarm, autodefense fires your batteries at incoming missiles, and emp runs the EMP tower. Insert it in a computer and run radarwatch.

quests.title: Abandoned Silo Complex
quests.desc: Old missile bases lie buried in the Overworld and on every planet with solid ground. A complex is about 240 by 240 blocks and 24 blocks down, with a hub, wide halls and hallways branching into 35 to 40 rooms, and a gallery of four to ten real silos. On the surface you see only concrete shafts, sometimes a small radar hut, and an escape-ladder trapdoor. Nothing in a complex is better than its planet's ceiling: EV in the Overworld and on the Moon, and one voltage tier more for each rocket tier above it. The sign in the Assembly Bay names the class. Guards wait at the posts, and a post you break stays broken. A Data Stick in a Comms chest names the nearest other complex. Find a complex and walk its hall.

quests.title: Take Over a Silo
quests.desc: Every silo in a complex is a real Missile Silo with its hatches in place, missing exactly one part: a concrete block where the controller goes, or a clear glass block under it where the Energy Hatch goes. Look for the part in the Safe, Stockpile, Workshop and Control chests, or craft it, then put it in and the silo forms. A found Energy Hatch is EV, which launches up to Tier 2; fit a LuV hatch for Tier 3. Clear the guard posts first, then power it and add a Launch Control. Repair a silo.

quests.title: Radar Station
quests.desc: The radar huts on a complex's surface hold a small radar with its Energy Hatch left out. Mine the Radar Casing under the radar controller, put an HV Energy Hatch in its place and power it. The radar forms and its dish starts to turn. Link it to a battery with a Data Stick as for any radar. Bring a radar station online.
